# ArtiBot Cloud MCP - Robot Fleet Management

ArtiBot Cloud MCP from Zhijiangyun: 15 tools for robot fleet management and GPU workloads.

## Capability surface

- Robot fleet management operations
- GPU workload tooling
- OAuth 2.0 authentication
- Endpoint verified live at catalog time (401 auth-gated, which is the expected response for an authenticated MCP endpoint)

## Auth

OAuth 2.0. A 401 from an unauthenticated client is expected and does not mean the endpoint is down.

## Status

Catalogued from vendor documentation and endpoint verification. Deep-dive page pending further capability confirmation.
